TOPIC 6.6
Applying Properties 
of Definite Integrals

SUGGESTED SKILLS  

Justification

3.D
Apply an appropriate 
mathematical definition, 
theorem, or test.

LEARNING OBJECTIVE

FUN-6.A
Calculate a definite integral 
using areas and properties of 
definite integrals.

ESSENTIAL KNOWLEDGE

FUN-6.A.1
In some cases, a definite integral can be 
evaluated by using geometry and the 
connection between the definite integral and 
area.

FUN-6.A.2
Properties of definite integrals include the 
integral of a constant times a function, the 
integral of the sum of two functions, reversal 
of limits of integration, and the integral of a 
function over adjacent intervals.

FUN-6.A.3
The definition of the definite integral may be 
extended to functions with removable or jump 
discontinuities.

ENDURING UNDERSTANDING

FUN-6
Recognizing opportunities to apply knowledge of geometry and mathematical rules 
can simplify integration.
